title: manni core strict (1.0.0-proposal.1)
description: The strict overlay for manni:core:1.0.0-proposal.4. Stack it beside the open draft. It narrows the form of values the draft already claims and requires no key.

title.description: Strict holds the title to one line with no leading or trailing whitespace.

description.description: Strict rejects leading or trailing whitespace. The description may still span several lines.

id.description: Strict holds the id to kebab case, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

type.description: Strict holds the type to kebab case, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

keywords.description: Strict takes keywords as a list only, so the comma-separated string form fails. The list is non-empty and unique, and each keyword is trimmed.

language.description: Strict holds the language to a well-formed BCP 47 tag, such as `en`, `pt-BR` or `zh-Hant-TW`.

locale.description: Strict holds the locale to a well-formed BCP 47 tag in hyphen form, so the underscore form `en_US` fails.

kebab.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

trimmed.description: One line with no leading or trailing whitespace.

bcp47.description: A well-formed RFC 5646 language tag, or a private-use tag that starts with `x-`. Well-formed means the tag has the right shape. The registry is not consulted.
